lines.text: Herod hears people say Jesus is John the Baptist risen from the dead, or Elijah, or a prophet.
Herod had John arrested and imprisoned because John said it was not lawful to have his brother Philip's wife Herodias.
Herodias wanted John dead, but Herod's disciples protected him, since Herod knew John was righteous and holy.

wrong_details.true: Herod feared John and protected him

lines.text: At a banquet on Herod's birthday, Herod promised the dancing girl up to half his kingdom, and her father told her to ask for John's head.

wrong_details.wrong: her father told her to ask for John's head
wrong_details.true: her mother told her to ask for John's head

lines.text: Herod grieved but kept his oaths, John was beheaded in prison, and John's disciples laid his body in a tomb.
